01-operating-system-basics.md.description: Module 02 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 1 --- An Operating System (OS) is system software that manages all the hardware and software resources of a computer. It acts as a bridge (interface) between the user and the computer hardware. Without an operating system, a computer is just a collection of useless electronic parts. 02-windows-gui-components.md.description: Module 02 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 2 --- GUI stands for Graphical User Interface. It allows users to interact with the computer using visual elements like windows, icons, buttons, and menus — instead of typing text commands. Before GUI, users had to type commands in a text-based interface (like DOS). GUI made computers easy enough for anyone to use — even absolute beginners. CCC Exam Tip: GUI = Graphical User Interface. 04-os-settings-configuration.md.description: Module 02 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 4 --- Windows allows you to customize and configure many settings to suit your needs. These settings are available through two main locations: 1. Settings App (Modern — Windows 10/11) 2. Control Panel (Classic — available in all Windows versions) Both let you change system settings, but the Settings app is newer and more visual, while the Control Panel is the traditional way with more detailed options....

05-file-types-extensions.md.title: File Types and Extensions
05-file-types-extensions.md.description: Module 02 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 5 --- A file extension is the part of a file name that comes after the last dot (.). It tells the computer (and you) what type of file it is and which program should open it. Example: resume.docx - resume = file name - .docx = file extension (tells us it is a Microsoft Word document) When you double-click a file, Windows looks at the extension to decide which program to use.
